title: eat shit & die 226
author: bpatrick
body: Finally, a comic. I hate to go black and white but it is so much faster. I start my new schedule Monday and I’ve got my fingers crossed that there will be more time for comics.

comments.author: bachterman
comments.text: which switch switches the witch switching bitch?

comments.author: kevin
comments.text:
Beauty in the eye of the beholder an all.

We all have our fingers crossed your new schedule leads to more time for comics!

comments.text:
A considerate witch!

And bonus points for the Haters-Gonna style walk in the last panel.
